title: The 40 Second Trap That Unmasks Kira Part 1

series.summary: Light counts down the seconds expecting victory, but when the 40 seconds expire without a single death, Near reveals the tampered notebook with only Light's name missing, completely exposing him as Kira.

cuts.voiceover_text: In forty seconds, everyone in this warehouse is supposed to drop dead. Watching from inside, Light Yagami tracks his watch while his accomplice writes down every name outside. The seconds tick down toward zero. Light can barely contain his dark excitement. He counts out loud, flashes an arrogant smirk, and boldly declares his victory.

Nearly a minute drags by in total silence, but nobody falls dead. Sitting calmly on the floor, Near breaks the quiet and asks why no one has collapsed. Light is instantly stunned. His confident grin freezes into sheer panic as cold sweat pours down his face. Outside, his accomplice trembles in disbelief.

To prove what happened, Near calls for the confiscated notebook and displays the physical evidence. He turns the pages and reads every single written victim aloud to the room. The real names of the SPK agents appear first, followed by the Japanese Task Force detectives. Then Near reveals the fatal twist: the only person in the entire warehouse whose name was not written down is Light Yagami.

Before Light can scramble for an excuse, Mikami shatters any remaining doubt. Panicking outside the door, the accomplice openly addresses Light as his God, desperately pleading to know why his instructions failed. Near calmly announces the case is settled. Light stands completely petrified, his eyes darting frantically in cornered dread. His own task force detectives stare back in horror, realizing their leader is Kira.

Near then explains how the trap worked. Anticipating the plot, he had secretly swapped the real notebook pages with exact duplicates before arriving. Hearing this, Light completely breaks down. He clutches his trembling head, backing away in wild denial, and screams that he is being framed.

As Light desperately tries to deny the evidence, his former allies shut down every exit. Detective Aizawa steps directly in front of him, warning that denial is useless and that Near has already won. Aizawa reminds him of his fatal mistake: just seconds before the deadline, Light had openly bragged that he won. Cornered by his own confession, Light stands isolated under the lights with nowhere left to run. Can Kira find any way out?
